events.title: An explosion in a football stadium in Mogadishu , Somalia kills 15 people when new prime minister Ali Mohammed Ghedi begins his speech. Authorities later state that a security guard accidentally set off a grenade . (IOL) (IHT)
Ligue 1 – Lyon win its fourth French title in 2000s (decade).

위건 애슬레틱 finish second in the Championship and are promoted to the Premier League – giving them top-flight football for the first time in their history. They were only elected to the Football League 27 years previously and reached the second tier of the English league just two years before.
하비에르 사네티 , captain of the 인테르 football club, says the team could accept the invitation to a game to play against Mexico 's Zapatistarebels . (BBC)

Malcolm Glazer gained control of 맨체스터 유나이티드 after buying the 28.9% share owned by Irish businessmen and horse racing magnates J. P. McManus and John Magnier . With this purchase, Glazer officially launched his bid for a complete takeover.
Malcolm Glazer wins control of UK football team 맨체스터 유나이티드 F.C. after securing a 70% share. (BBC) (ABC News) (NY Times)
Spain Liga – 바르셀로나 won its 17th league title.

Also on the last day of the Premiership, 미들즈브러 goalkeeper 마크 슈워처 saves a Robbie Fowler penalty in stoppage time to preserve a 1–1 draw at 맨체스터 시티 , allowing Boro to finish seventh and grab the final UEFA Cup berth. If Fowler had converted, 맨체스터 시티 would have gone to the UEFA Cup instead of the Teessiders .

크리스털 팰리스 , 노리치 시티 and 사우샘프턴 are relegated from the Premiership on the last day of the season, finishing 18th, 19th and 20th respectively. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 , which started the day at the bottom of the table, complete an improbable escape to become the first club since the creation of the Premier League in 1992–93 to survive after being the bottom team at Christmas. Their survival was achieved with a 2–0 home win over 포츠머스, while 크리스털 팰리스 had been less than ten minutes from safety when 찰턴 애슬레틱 equalised against them. 노리치 시티 could have saved themselves regardless of what happened to the other three teams had they won at 풀럼, but instead were hammered 6–0 in the showdown at Craven Cottage . 사우샘프턴's survival bid ended with a 2–1 home defeat by 맨체스터 유나이티드, drawing the curtain on 27 successive seasons of top-flight football at the club.
Malcolm Glazer announces that he has acquired 75% of the shares of 맨체스터 유나이티드 . This level of ownership will enable him to delist the club from the London Stock Exchange , which he has pledged to do.
UEFA Cup Final – CSKA Moscow became the first Russian club to win a major European club competition, defeating 스포르팅 3–1 at Sporting's home field in Lisbon.
Italian Serie A – 유벤투스 won its 28th title ("scudetto") without playing following a 3–3 draw between A.C. AC 밀란 and 팔레르모 .
Manager Gert Aandewiel receives the Rinus Michels Award for the best coach in Dutch amateur football.

아스널 beat Manchester Utd on penalties in the FA Cup Final after no goals were scored in normal or extra time, this being the first final to be decided on penalties. Patrick Vieira converted the winning spot-kick in what was his last game for the Gunners.
아스널 wins the FA Cup Final by defeating 맨체스터 유나이티드 5–4 on penalties after regular time and extra time ended 0–0.

리버풀 win the European Cup for a fifth time, beating AC 밀란 3–2 on penalties after extra time. AC 밀란 went ahead 3–0 in the first half, but 리버풀 scored three goals in the first 15 minutes of the second half to level the score.
2004–05 UEFA Champions League Final – 리버풀 come from three goals down, and beat A.C. AC 밀란 3–2 on penalties after a 3–3 draw in Istanbul to win Europe's top prize for the 5th time.

At Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul , 리버풀 F.C. scores three goals in six minutes to tie the game and after extra-time goes on to defeat AC 밀란 3-2 in a penalty shootout to win its first UEFA Champions League title since 1984 . Goals from 스티븐 제라드 , Vladimír Šmicer and 샤비 알론소 levelled he game in the second half.리버풀 eventually winning 3-2 on penalties In one of the greatest comebacks in sporting history
Dutch club 스파르타 로테르담 fires manager Mike Snoei and names former international Adri van Tiggelen as interim-coach.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 achieve promotion back to the Premier League after 2 years away with a 1–0 victory over 프레스턴 노스 엔드 in the Championship play-off final .
